name: obsidian-livesync
title: Obsidian LiveSync
description: A CouchDB tuned for the Self-hosted LiveSync plugin, so your Obsidian vaults sync between every device through your own server. In the plugin's setup wizard use this URL (behind Traefik: https://obsidian-livesync.<your domain>), the username and password below, and any database name.

variables.name: COUCHDB_USER
variables.label: Username
variables.description: Admin user the plugin logs in with

variables.name: COUCHDB_PASSWORD
variables.label: Password
variables.description: Set it here and paste it into the plugin
